info.name: Spike.sh Alert Rules Planned Maintenances API

description.content:
REST API for managing incidents, on-call schedules, escalation policies, services, integrations, and alerting rules within the Spike.sh incident management platform. Spike.sh provides phone, SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, and Microsoft Teams notifications, along with status pages, war rooms, and 80+ integrations.
